text_markup: The symbol [sub] (plaintext: {curly:sub}) stands for "subroutine". Each symbol marks a single subroutine on a piece of ice. See {ref:sec_subroutines} for information about subroutines.
text_plain: The symbol {sub} (plaintext: {sub}) stands for "subroutine". Each symbol marks a single subroutine on a piece of ice. See section 9.8 for information about subroutines.
